fusions.name: Drop It and Run
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A cut that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. For 3 seconds after you use it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Tail Whip
fusions.desc: Whips an arc 4 tiles ahead that deals 11 damage to everything in it, knocks each back 2 tiles and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bask
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Noon Edge
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage.
